title: ICJ provisional measure concerning the Rafah offensive
summary: The Court reaffirmed and added provisional measures after assessing changed circumstances in Rafah.
claim: The Court ordered Israel immediately to halt its military offensive, and any other action in the Rafah Governorate, which may inflict on the Palestinian group in Gaza conditions of life that could bring about its physical destruction in whole or in part.
legal_characterization: Binding provisional measure in an ICJ case; no final determination that genocide occurred.
source_title: Order of 24 May 2024, Application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
source_quote: immediately halt its military offensive, and any other action in the Rafah Governorate
verification_notes: Verified against the cited ICJ order, including its operative clause. This is a binding provisional measure at an interim stage; it is not a final merits finding that genocide occurred. Classification judgment: categorization as displacement reflects the order’s factual context; the operative wording is reproduced without resolving differing interpretations of its scope, so manual review is requested.
